business_problem: BEN Group needed a scalable way to analyze huge volumes of media, creator, and audience data so brands could place product integrations and influencer spend more effectively while also detecting fraud and improving return on advertising investment.
solution_summary: BEN Group built its media and influencer analytics workflow on NVIDIA DGX A100 so the company could process far more video, image, text, and audio content than human analysts could review. The DGX A100 platform lets BEN ingest terabytes of unstructured data, analyze around 100,000 Instagram posts per week, and train customized algorithms that predict impressions, views, clicks, and conversions across film, television, streaming, music videos, and social platforms. The same AI layer identifies fraudulent influencers and bot activity, helping clients avoid wasted spend while prioritizing creator partnerships that match campaign goals. By accelerating both model training and large-scale content analysis, BEN turned influencer and product-placement planning into a data-driven recommendation system rather than a manual judgment exercise.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA DGX A100
solution_components.role: Provides the accelerated training and analytics infrastructure BEN uses to process terabytes of media data and train campaign-optimization models.

data_flow: Structured and unstructured media data-such as video, audio, images, text, audience signals, and influencer activity-is ingested into DGX A100-backed AI pipelines. BEN's models then score creator and content opportunities, predict funnel outcomes, and flag suspicious behavior before recommendations are delivered to brand clients.
integration_points: Streaming, television, music, and social-media content
business_outcome: BEN analyzes media data 4x faster than before, processes 100,000 Instagram posts per week, helped some clients cut customer acquisition cost by 32 percent, and increased conversion rates by 39 percent while making influencer and product-placement campaigns more targeted and efficient.
